howTo.title: How to take part
howTo.intro: Every float has its own team of players. Message us and we'll tell you how to join the piece you like most.
howTo.ctaNote: We reply directly on WhatsApp. We coordinate with the maker.

carnival.title: The carnival
carnival.intro: Every January, Pasto transforms. During the first week of the year the city celebrates the Carnival of Blacks and Whites, recognised by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

days.title: The big days
days.text: January 5 is the Day of the Blacks and January 6 the Day of the Whites, with the Grand Parade of floats closing the celebration.

hands.title: Artisan hands
hands.text: Behind every float are months of work by masters and workshops shaping cardboard, paper and paint.

route.title: This route
route.text: La Ruta del Carnaval brings you closer to those workshops and their pieces, before they hit the street.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. Tell us which piece interests you and we'll reply.

footer.text: Pasto, Colombia · Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
footer.rights: Sample content. Photographs subject to permissions.

dynamics.title: Dynamics
dynamics.intro: We're preparing ways to live the carnival beyond the parade: votes, awards and surprises for everyone following the route.
dynamics.teaserText: Vote for your favorite float and help pick the piece that won people over the most.

experiences.title: Carnival Experience
experiences.intro: A guided tour in two stops: the Carnival Museum and an artisan's workshop, where you carve and paper with your own hands. You take home a carnival keepsake.
